name: TriageAgent
description: Classifies every failed test of the latest Playwright run (product_defect, test_defect.locator/data, environment, flaky, known_issue, unknown) with evidence, before healing; re-runs environment and flaky candidates and asks an LLM, with cited evidence, only for what stays unknown.

inputs.name: report_json
inputs.description: Playwright JSON report to triage (default: latest in test_execution/reports/json)

inputs.name: triage_reruns
inputs.description: false = classify only, no health check / re-runs / LLM (default true)

outputs.name: triage
outputs.description: Path of test_execution/reports/triage.json (verdict + evidence per failed test)

outputs.name: defects
outputs.description: Path of test_execution/reports/defects.json (product_defect failures, never healed)
